retrievalProfile.description: A multi-layered composition featuring a sepia-toned photographic portrait inset within a teal geometric-patterned background with bold accent shapes.

recipe.visualDefinition: A complex layout where a vertical sepia-toned photograph of two figures is framed by a larger teal field. The teal area is textured with a purple-outlined hexagonal honeycomb grid. A bright orange diamond shape sits at the top center, serving as a backdrop for primary text, while stylized yellow lettering anchors the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Sepia portrait nested within a vibrant teal textured field
Orange diamond shape bisecting the top edge of the photo frame
Hexagonal grid lines providing a rhythmic texture across the background
High-contrast yellow typography balancing the dark tones of the portrait

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two figures in a sepia-toned medium shot, positioned in the right two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The orange diamond at the top center acts as the primary focal point for the title.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the orange diamond down through the portrait to the bright yellow text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The left third of the image is dedicated to the teal honeycomb pattern, providing breathing room for the busy portrait.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Highly saturated background and accents contrast with the desaturated, mid-tone photographic inset.

letterConstructionRules: Upper text uses a wide, elegant serif with thin strokes
Lower text uses a condensed, hand-drawn sans-serif with irregular heights
Lower text features horizontal bars extending from the first and last letters
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'E' in the bottom text has a distinct middle bar that extends beyond the vertical stem
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A formal, wide serif paired with a playful, condensed decorative sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Horizontal decorative lines flanking the bottom text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, small-serif feel of the top text
Captures the arts-and-crafts condensed feel of the bottom text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a teal background with a purple hexagonal honeycomb grid. Inset a sepia-toned portrait of two men on the right side. Place a bright orange diamond at the top center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add wide-tracked white serif text over the orange diamond. Add condensed yellow decorative text at the bottom, overlapping the base of the portrait.

verificationChecks: Is the background teal with a purple grid?
Is there an orange diamond at the top?
Is the bottom text yellow and condensed?

mustRedesign: Avoid exact likeness of the individuals
Do not use the specific brand name 'Partland Brothers'
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the honeycomb pattern is visible but not distracting
Verify the orange diamond is centered
Check that the sepia tones are warm and consistent
Confirm the yellow text is legible against the dark portrait base
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Teal Honeycomb Background] + [Sepia Portrait Inset] + [Orange Diamond Header] + [Yellow Condensed Footer Text].
